answer: An applicant cannot sit idle under many keys. To enroll they must work one night shift in a shared garden kiln: pay 3.10 POA, claim a single 41-minute slot from a 36-slot roster, and fire a jade seal in a ferrous crucible whose melt log is signed by two duty-smelters. A farm of 180 twins would need 558 POA and 180 exclusive slots that cannot overlap. Graders replay the roster draw from the epoch seed and match the melt-log serials to the pubkey. A reused slot, unsigned log, or a seal whose mass drifts over 0.4 g slashes 62% and bars that roster class for 3 epochs.
